text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Training on your own even after 
returning to the dorms? You're as 
dedicated as always.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I still have strength left today. I cannot 
simply rest like this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
However, it is almost time. I must move on 
to my studies.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
△EBD and △ACD have a similarity ratio of 
1:4. Therefore, we can find the length of 
AB and use the Pythagorean theorem... I 
see—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Those dumbbells... Don't tell me you're 
studying and working out at the same time 
again?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I haven't pushed myself hard enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Only by training to the absolute limit can 
one prove that realm—that is what true 
strength is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, you're always so stoic. But 
please don't push yourself too hard, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I'll keep that firmly in mind.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is it that time already? ...To think I 
could have such a fulfilling training 
session.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll be able to sleep 
comfortably tonight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew... I guess that's about it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Finally, let's check tomorrow's training 
schedule, and... that's a wrap."
